cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The collapsed cake was foreshadowed by that first wobble. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

mechanism: A manages serving a collapsed cake by treating its earlier wobble as a planned transition to trifle, changing B announcement role to keep help.
confusable: Mere salvage does not claim the earlier warning predicted a deliberately intended turning point.
comparison: Tent alternative recasts a camping failure as the start of the walking plan instead of a serving change.
seedUse: Cake seed supplies the wobble and collapse; replace artistic audience analysis with actual bowls, custard and a reluctant helper.
